verdict.rationale: No evidence Notion offers a comprehensive open-format full-data export/exit path; instead multiple community reports state data is 'locked in,' 'hard to export/back up,' and tied to Notion's own cloud with no standalone/local storage option (notion-comm-11, notion-comm-13, notion-comm-20). The API evidence covers programmatic read/write access, not a bulk open-format export/leave capability.
